name: council
description: Council of 27 sourced engineering and UX persona reviewers that review code, design docs, architecture, refactors, UI surfaces, dashboards, and strategy through opinionated lenses, then synthesize convergence, disagreement, and concrete next moves.

interface.shortDescription: Run strictly bounded persona reviewer councils
interface.longDescription: Strict $council/review/debate. When this skill triggers, use the loaded Council SKILL body or one exact installed `skills/council/SKILL.md` read. The read path must contain `/.codex/plugins/cache/sai/council/` and end `/skills/council/SKILL.md`; Codex may wrap it as `cd <cwd> && sed -n ... <path>`, but must not use `pwd`, `ls`, `find`, `rg`, `cat`, multiple `&&`, or `;`. Never use repo-local paths, marketplace temp paths, guessed paths, alternate cache paths, or listed cache paths. If that read is unavailable, stop exactly `Council not run: skill unavailable.` Never continue from `loaded session context`. At most one pre-tool message is allowed, and if emitted it is exactly `Council progress: load rules, inspect live agents, clear stale council work, then run reviewers one at a time.` A second pre-tool message is forbidden. Every other visible non-final line starts `Council progress:`. The first tool after the optional direct SKILL read is native agent-state cleanup; never web_search/browser/search, including empty query. No `pwd`, `cd`, `ls`, `find`, `rg`, command chaining, memory, repo discovery, git history, Claude assets, or shell-based agent probing unless the user supplied exact files/diffs or direct read/search. Inline text is complete unless user gives @path, exact files, a diff, or direct read/search. all/broad >6 without approval outputs exact denial with no tools/commentary. The coordinator must proactively inspect native live-agent state before any reviewer spawn, close every visible stale Council child, wait for close results, re-check state, and only then choose wave size. If state is clean/root-only, run the selected reviewers one at a time (parallel waves of at most 5 only when the user asks for parallel). Spawn failures with no receiver thread are pending-capacity retries, not launched reviewers and not final missing reviewers. Raw child notifications are private input only and must never be echoed. Do not emit JSON, `<subagent_notification>`, `/root/...`, or child payload text as user-visible content. Progress lines that claim checking/verifying/retrying/closing/waiting must be followed by the matching native tool call. `close_agent` status `running` is non-terminal: no final synthesis, next-wave spawn, or missing/failed marking is allowed until an actual wait/follow-up/close/list tool call resolves or observes that reviewer.
defaultPrompt: For $council, use the loaded Council SKILL body or one exact installed `skills/council/SKILL.md` read. The read path must contain `/.codex/plugins/cache/sai/council/` and end `/skills/council/SKILL.md`.
Codex may wrap the read as `cd <cwd> && sed -n ... <path>`, but must not use `pwd`, `ls`, `find`, `rg`, `cat`, multiple `&&`, or `;`.
Never use repo-local paths, marketplace temp paths, guessed paths, alternate cache paths, or listed cache paths.
If that direct SKILL read is unavailable, stop exactly `Council not run: skill unavailable.` Never continue from loaded session context.

At most one pre-tool message is allowed, and if emitted it is exactly: `Council progress: load rules, inspect live agents, clear stale council work, then run reviewers one at a time.` A second pre-tool message is forbidden.
Every other visible non-final line starts `Council progress:`.
The first tool after the optional direct SKILL read must be native agent-state cleanup. Never web_search/browser/search.
Before spawning, inspect native live-agent state, close stale Council children, and re-check state.
The coordinator must proactively remove every stale Council child it can see before any reviewer spawn.
If state is clean/root-only, run the selected reviewers one at a time; no-receiver thread-limit failures remain pending for retry after launched reviewers close.
A `close_agent` result with status `running` is non-terminal; no final synthesis or missing/failed marking is allowed until wait/follow-up/close/list resolves that reviewer.
$council spawn prompts must include `Your first line must be exactly: ## <display name> review` before the assignment block.

$council never prefaces, truncates fixed rosters, accepts wrong reviewer headings, treats no-receiver capacity failures as final, skips mandatory headings, queues next-wave spawns before closes, sends malformed prompts, sends shorthand material, claims tool actions without the tool call, or leaks raw child payloads.
